metadata.note: Values are pilot defaults with an evidence label in the decision log (D-xx). null = unresolved. Freeze a copy per experiment before Phase 7. v2.1 (1 Oct): Phase 3 world built; placeholders filled with ASSUMED values (D-16 to D-22); scenario contract docs/technical/scenario_contract.md; pre-registration docs/technical/preregistration.md.

service.after_midnight_date_rule: rides after 00:00 belong to the previous service night (D-03)
service.rules_source: PROVISIONAL (earlier 20/25-minute discussion; not a verified Hopkins rule) (D-04)

fleet.shift_end_rule: stop new assignments at shift end; finish onboard riders

demand.count_rule: fixed n per scenario; Poisson(n) as a variant (D-20)
demand.endpoint_rule: requests start/end at the digitized bubbles themselves, weighted by count (D-16)
demand.od_model: bubble-level gravity x IPF to the April O/D margins (D-18); src/scenario/demand.py

spatial.unknown_mass_rule: cut/hidden bubbles at lower bound, then margins scaled to the city-map fence ~24,056 (D-09)

travel.source: OSRM demo server, car, free-flow: v0 tables retrieved 2026-09-29; tt_locations_v1 (full 188x188) retrieved 2026-10-01
travel.local_server: OSRM v6.0.0 local at 127.0.0.1:5050 (docs/technical/osrm_local.md); Geofabrik Maryland, OSM timestamp 2026-10-01T20:22:06Z, md5 ff90439c...; matrix data/processed/tt_locations_v2.csv (built 2026-10-02); not yet used by the generator (Phase 3 v2 decision)

simulation.commitment_rule: freeze the current road movement and all onboard riders
simulation.reassignment_rule: assigned-but-not-picked-up may be reassigned by B and C alike
simulation.end_of_night_rule: run until every accepted rider is dropped off

players.H: offline node-arc MILP with the whole hour known (ceiling; bracketed)

solver.name: HiGHS (highspy)
solver.delay_accounting_rule: decisions instantaneous in simulated time; solve time logged; solve > W flagged

calibration.throughput_target: completed rides per van-hour at 6 pm (~6.2)

evaluation.random_stream_scheme: one stream per component (count, times, od, party, patience, fleet): SeedSequence(seed_base, spawn_key=(replicate, k)); common random numbers across cells
evaluation.primary_metric: timely passengers served (wait and ride within limits)
evaluation.primary_comparison: C vs B at the same W; ladder N-A-B-C-H
evaluation.minimum_meaningful_gain: +1.0 timely passenger per hour at base (about 3%); 3% relative elsewhere
evaluation.maximum_acceptable_harm: P90 wait +2 min or overflows +1 per hour
